findings.message: 28 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 3 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "T. Prolyman · Quartermaster", "Tier I", "Tier II").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): nav.aisles → linear-gradient(rgb(107, 70, 41), rgb(77, 49, 28) 7px, rgb(31, 19, 10) 14px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 14px) | header.cabinet-head → linear-gradient(rgb(155, 58, 42) 0px, rgb(155, 58, 42) 8px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 8px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 10px,
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.
Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
3 typefaces in use (system-ui, Cormorant Garamond, EB Garamond).
8 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 0px 8px 12px -6px | rgba(255, 196, 110, 0.55) 0px 14px 30px -8px | rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 0px 8px 12px -6px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.
An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).

findings.message: 2 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "Tier I", "Tier II"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Blades · Bows · Guns · Shot" (8px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 28 icons sit in tinted squares or circles.
findings.fix: This is the commonest tell of a generated dashboard. Drop the tinted square: a KPI is a label and a number; an icon, if it helps, is plain and in the text colour.
